# anthropic

These skills are copied from https://github.com/anthropics/skills at commit
`e4bb5d960d87126ff3b3a8af1a104b7db67560ba`, under the Apache-2.0 license.
Each skill's license is in its own `LICENSE.txt`.

RooAGI sets `license` and `source` in each SKILL.md frontmatter, renames a skill
to `anthropic-<name>` when another skill already has its name, and may append a
"RooAGI notes" section from `notes/anthropic/`; the rest is unchanged.

- `academy-guide`: `skills/academy-guide`
